purpose: Fresh terse player-language Gate 3 tranche J benchmark authored after r20 deployment and not used to construct r20.
blindnessPolicy: This tranche was authored after production health verified r20 and was not used to construct r20.
Do not edit or retroactively regrade this tranche after its first paid live run.
Do not exactly reuse prior Gate 2 or Gate 3 A/B/C/D/E/F/G/H/I player-language questions.
Semantic criteria are limited to the answer actually requested.

cases.question: opening discard is already in discard before turn 1?
expectedSourceGroups: forms the player's Discard Pile before the first turn begins

semanticCriteria.statement: Yes. The mandatory opening discard is already the Discard Pile before turn one begins.

cases.question: none of the listed choices legal. skip it?
expectedSourceGroups: If no valid option is available, that choice is ignored

semanticCriteria.statement: Yes. If no listed choice is valid, that choice is ignored.

cases.question: bound max dropped. excess cards discard?
expectedSourceGroups: discard excess bound cards until the limit is satisfied

semanticCriteria.statement: Yes. Immediately choose and discard excess bound cards until within the new maximum.

cases.question: both withdraw. attacker moves first?
expectedSourceGroups: if both players withdraw, move the attacker first, then the defender

semanticCriteria.statement: Yes. Resolve the attacker's withdrawal first, then the defender's.

cases.question: high command banked. can command hit 3?

semanticCriteria.statement: Yes. High Command raises the Military Command maximum to 3.

cases.question: latitude got refused. both refused effects?
expectedSourceGroups: Choose one Proposal before applying its Refused effect

semanticCriteria.statement: No. Choose one offered Proposal; only that Proposal's Refused effect applies.

cases.question: detente banked, old proposal accepted. +1 influence?
expectedSourceGroups: already ratified when you offered it, +1 Influence

semanticCriteria.statement: Yes, if this is the first such acceptance that turn.

cases.question: treasury value 4 means +4 income?
expectedSourceGroups: Treasury cards do not generate Capital by themselves

semanticCriteria.statement: No. Treasury value raises the Capital limit but does not itself generate Capital.
No. The Intel remains spent when Interference is prevented.

cases.question: special op math says 0 intel. still pay 1?

semanticCriteria.statement: Yes. Special Operation completion has a minimum payment of 1 Intel.

cases.question: have three rites. must do them in order?

semanticCriteria.statement: No. Any selected incomplete Rite may be begun when legal.

cases.question: ritual cards all from hand okay?
expectedSourceGroups: one Arcane card from your Hand, one from your Discard Pile, and one from your Graveyard

semanticCriteria.statement: No. The three Ritual cards must come one each from Hand, Discard Pile, and Graveyard.

cases.question: blasphemy gain uses up normal conviction gain?
expectedSourceGroups: outside the normal once-per-turn Conviction gain

semanticCriteria.statement: No. Blasphemy is separate from the normal once-per-turn Conviction gain.

cases.question: 3 conviction purge hits their hand?
expectedSourceGroups: opponent chooses one card from their Hand and puts it in their Graveyard

semanticCriteria.statement: Yes. The 3-Conviction Purge makes the opponent choose one Hand card to put in their Graveyard.

cases.question: line of credit collateral from treasury okay?

semanticCriteria.statement: Yes. Banker may use a card from Hand or Treasury as collateral.

cases.question: mission control starts next mission immediately?
expectedSourceGroups: immediately start another eligible Mission from Hand

semanticCriteria.statement: Yes. Mission Control immediately starts another eligible Mission from Hand.

cases.question: 1-cost purge with final judgment becomes free?

semanticCriteria.statement: No. Final Judgment's reduced Purge cost cannot go below 1.

cases.question: banked tariffs this turn. replace it for another asset?
expectedSourceGroups: cannot voluntarily cause it to leave play during the turn it is banked

semanticCriteria.statement: No. Tariffs cannot voluntarily leave play during the turn it was banked.
